name: localchat
description: LocalChat — self-hosted LAN chat with voice/video calls

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../electron && npm install
scripts.docker:rebuild: docker compose down && docker build --no-cache -t localchat . && docker compose up -d
scripts.desktop:pack:mac: cd client && npm run build && cd ../electron && npm run pack:mac
scripts.desktop:pack:win: cd client && npm run build && cd ../electron && npm run pack:win
scripts.desktop:pack:linux: cd client && npm run build && cd ../electron && npm run pack:linux
scripts.desktop:pack:all: cd client && npm run build && cd ../electron && npm run pack:all
